policy: Exact installed parser/source and runtime logs outrank static profiles. Unknown version-specific syntax is unverified, not automatically rewritten.

locked_claims: Supported keys are Form, Spell, Perk, Item, Shout, LevSpell, Package, Outfit, Keyword, Faction, SleepOutfit, and Skin; Final modifies Outfit.
Weapon is not a supported distribution key.
There are seven possible value sections and omitted trailing sections are filled empty.
TraitFilters split on forward slash and valid tokens include D and -D.
Chance is numeric and may have one trailing deterministic exclamation mark.
Validation must be field-aware.
LevelFilters split by comma; actor levels accept a minimum, half-open range, closed range, or exact min/min form.
Skill filters use skillIndex(min/max); exact skill values repeat the value, and skill indexes are 0-17.
KID uses human-readable record type labels.
Five value positions exist, but parser reads only positions present and trailing optional positions may be omitted.
Pipe syntax
Forms/References sections
Transforms/Properties direct override sections
Configuration must be beneath a category directory
Operations are category/version-specific
JSON rules are read from Data/SKSE/Plugins/ContainerDistributionFramework.
add is an array of exact form strings.
An unresolved add string causes that change to be skipped.
Wildcard-like category strings are not expanded by the pinned parser.
Feature descriptors are loaded from Data/Shaders/Features/<ShortName>.ini.
A failed descriptor load disables the feature.
Image Based Lighting uses the short name ImageBasedLighting.
FLM configurations use _FLM.ini or Data/FLM.
FLM special selectors such as *FormList, #Group, and #Collection are framework-specific.
FLM collections resolve exact keyword forms/EditorIDs and may depend on KID completion.
Missing forms are skipped and must be classified by dependency scope.
